facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa reports that a 2022 assessment found the civil registry a largely manual system marked by high costs, frequent errors and document-fraud risk.

On 25 March 2026 authorities validated in Moroni the preparatory studies for full digitisation of the civil registry system under the Amecc programme, including a Personal Identification Number and interoperability with other state systems.
facts.system: Amecc (Civil Registry Modernization Support Program in the Comoros)

facts.fact: The French Embassy funds the Amecc project and UNICEF provides technical support, as reported on 27 March 2026.
facts.system: Amecc (Civil Registry Modernization Support Program in the Comoros)

facts.fact: The government is reported to implement the civil registry digitisation through the Amecc programme, on the basis of the law of 27 July 2023 mandating computerised processing of civil registry data.
